title.narrative: Migrant Protection, Return and Reintegration (MPRR) programme in Sub-Saharan Africa

description.narrative: The main aim of the Action is to contribute to the protection of stranded and vulnerable migrants within Sub-Saharan Africa, and support assisted voluntary return and sustainable reintegration for returnees in the region. This will be done through a rights-based and comprehensive approach that puts migrant rights and partner country ownership at the centre. The Action will take place in Sub-Saharan Africa, and in particular in countries of the Atlantic/Western and Central Mediterranean routes.
